UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location 'prometheus'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'data' | Out-Null; $v = '{{ServerVersion}}'; if (-not $v) { $v = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing 'https://api.github.com/repos/prometheus/prometheus/releases/latest').tag_name }; if ($v -notmatch '^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$') { Write-Output ('Invalid Prometheus version format specified: ' + $v); exit 1 }; $n = $v.Substring(1); if ((Test-Path 'server/prometheus.exe') -and (Test-Path 'server/.installed-version') -and ((Get-Content 'server/.installed-version' -Raw).Trim() -eq $n)) { Write-Output ('Prometheus ' + $v + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -OutFile 'prometheus.zip' ('https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/' + $v + '/prometheus-' + $n + '.windows-amd64.zip') } catch { Remove-Item 'prometheus.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Download failed from GitHub. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'extract') { Remove-Item 'extract' -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path 'prometheus.zip' -DestinationPath 'extract' -Force; if (Test-Path 'server') { Remove-Item 'server' -Recurse -Force }; Move-Item -Path (Get-ChildItem 'extract' -Directory | Select-Object -First 1).FullName -Destination 'server'; Remove-Item 'extract','prometheus.zip' -Recurse -Force; Set-Content -Path 'server/.installed-version' -Value $n; Write-Output ('Prometheus ' + $v + ' installed')"

-c "ServerVersion=\"{{ServerVersion}}\"; Arch=\"amd64\"; cd prometheus || exit 1; mkdir -p server data; if [[ -z \"$ServerVersion\" ]]; then ServerVersion=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/prometheus/prometheus/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi; if [[ ! \"$ServerVersion\" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Prometheus version format specified: $ServerVersion\"; exit 1; fi; Version=\"${ServerVersion#v}\"; if [[ -x server/prometheus && \"$(cat server/.installed-version 2>/dev/null)\" == \"$Version\" ]]; then echo \"Prometheus $ServerVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -f prometheus.tar.gz; wget -qO prometheus.tar.gz \"https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/$ServerVersion/prometheus-$Version.linux-$Arch.tar.gz\" || { rm -f prometheus.tar.gz; echo \"Download failed from GitHub. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf server && mkdir -p server && tar -xzf prometheus.tar.gz -C server --strip-components=1 && rm -f prometheus.tar.gz && chmod +x server/prometheus server/promtool && echo \"$Version\" > server/.installed-version && echo \"Prometheus $ServerVersion installed\""
